column1: # JLPT kanji by level - local reference table.
# The JLPT has published no official list since the 2010 overhaul: the levels
# here are settled by consensus, and each level holds at most its usual share
# of the 100 / 300 / 650 / 1,000 kanji the levels are said to ask for, counted
# from N5 up; N1 holds the rest of the Joyo table. Only the Joyo kanji carry a
# level: a kanji used in names (伊, 翔) is not what the exam reads.
# Within a level, the most frequent kanji first. Columns: level <TAB> kanji.
